category_title: Reluctant stayers who use inappropriate language and avoid academic tasks
scenario_title: Prevocational English drafting in computer lab
minimal_context: The student is in a computer lab working on drafting a persuasive marketing brochure for an assessment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your computer and start drafting your persuasive marketing brochure.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This business proposal is bullshit. It's too hard and completely irrelevant to me. I'm literally only at school so I don't have to be unemployed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to keep working on the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and walks away from the computer) I'm not doing it. I'm going over to the other desks to talk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back to your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Fuck off, I'm not going back to my desk. I've been in this lab for 70 minutes and I haven't typed a single word of this crap, and I'm not starting now.

TUTOR: Please come back to your desk.

task.content: a persuasive marketing brochure, the second a script for a business proposal to be delivered in a speech

context.social_setting: individual seatwork with teacher monitoring and individual teacher-student dialogue

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when the teacher repeatedly protested about students' swearing and redirected off task behaviour
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: swearing, off task behaviour, not at desk (Can you please come back to your desk), doing little work (That's it? All you've done in 70 minutes?)
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: find the curriculum irrelevant or too hard

behavior_patterns.condition: when expected to work independently on assignments
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: swearing, talking instead of working, leaving desk
behavior_patterns.internal_state: experience of schooling is negative: they do not get on with teachers
related_quotes: Can you please stop the language. I don't like it!
